description: Save an SSH public key so SSH rentals accept it (the key also shows on the account's SSH keys page). Pass the PUBLIC key line, e.g. the contents of ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub; never a private key. To make one: ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -N '' -f ~/.ssh/paralon_ed25519, then add the .pub file's line and connect with -i ~/.ssh/paralon_ed25519. A key added after a rental started is not on that rental. No cost.

name.description: Optional label, e.g. 'laptop' or 'claude-agent'. Defaults to the key's comment.

public_key.description: One OpenSSH public key line: 'ssh-ed25519 AAAA… comment' (ed25519, ecdsa or rsa ≥2048).

name: add_ssh_key
